build_hifigan_generator: build a HiFi-GAN Generator module from a config dict to synthesize waveforms from mel-spectrograms
create_resblock: create a ResBlock with configurable channels, kernel size, and dilation for residual feature extraction
init_conv_weights: initialize convolutional layer weights using a normal distribution with configurable mean and standard deviation
compute_dilated_padding: compute the correct padding value for a dilated 1D convolution given kernel size and dilation
remove_weight_norm_generator: remove weight normalization from a HiFi-GAN Generator for inference or model export
